issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

credentials.description:
How to access the data in the datastore.  Override to provide things such as endpoint, username, password,
etc. as appropriate.

cloudId.description: C3 Cloud Identifier for backing infrastructure that hosts the Datastore ex: {@link PostgresDb#id}, {@link CassandraDb#id}

disabled.description: True if the datastore is disabled (e.g. no data access is permitted).

readOnly.description: True if the datastore is read only, i.e. can only be queried.

external.description: True if the datastore is external, i.e. its database schema can not be altered.

perTenant.description:
True if every environment should have their own {@link Cassandra.Keyspace}. This has no effect for
any database other than Cassandra.

dedicated.description: True if the db is shared with other apps or it is dedicated.

validateConnections.description: Set to true to validate connections on borrow from the connection pool.
